affected.note: Maximum figure. Breakdown: 3,210,421 Carsensor.net users who sent inquiries to dealers, 5,289 review posters, 483,168 dealers registered with C-MATCH, and 10,673 employees, contractors and agency staff. Recruit said payment card data and login passwords were not included.

summary.en: Recruit detected suspicious external access to systems of its used-car site Carsensor.net on 2026-10-17 and suspended related services including the dealer service C-MATCH. It announced that up to 3,709,551 records, mostly names and addresses of users who had contacted dealers, may have leaked.
summary.ja: リクルートは2026年10月17日に中古車情報サイト「カーセンサーnet」のシステムへの不審な外部アクセスを検知し、販売店向けサービス「C-MATCH」などを停止した。販売店に問い合わせた利用者の氏名や住所を中心に、最大3,709,551件の個人情報が漏えいした可能性があると発表した。
